title: Decision Table: Record Multiple in the Recalculation of a Security Deposit
content:
In the recalculation of a held Security Deposits deposit at the member's request, the record multiple reads the account's last twenty-four whole months: the returned payments and the reconnect fees on its Electric Service by Rate Schedule account.

## Rule

The recalculation multiple starts from the record multiple the account earns. No returned payment and no reconnect fee takes the clean record multiple of **1.75**; no returned payment but a reconnect fee takes the reconnected record multiple of **1.9**; any returned payment takes neither of these multiples.

## Decision table

| Returned payments, last twenty-four whole months | Reconnect fees, last twenty-four whole months | Record multiple |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 1.75 |
| none | one or more | 1.9 |
| one or more | any | neither figure |

A single returned payment in the twenty-four months is enough to take the account out of both figures, whatever its reconnect fees.
